answer: In an agent marketplace trading game assets such as ember spells, mirror shields, and ivory towers, each voting identity must lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days to receive one vote. Creating accounts is cheap, but activating 1,000 voting identities requires locking 100,000 tokens for the full period. Splitting funds across fake agents grants no extra votes per token, so a sybil swarm must tie up capital in proportion to its influence.
